title: Google Calendar
connectIntro: Connect the clinic calendar so the assistant can check free times and book appointments over WhatsApp.
reauthNotice: Google denied access to the calendar. Reconnect so the assistant can book again.
timeZoneWarning: The calendar is set to {{timeZone}}: times offered to customers will be calculated in that zone. Change the time zone in the Google Calendar settings and reload this page.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect the calendar? The assistant stops offering and booking times until you connect again.

notices.denied: Authorization was cancelled on the Google screen. Nothing changed.
notices.error: Could not connect the calendar. Please try again.
notices.missing_scope: Calendar access was not authorized. Connect again and keep all permissions checked.

errors.connect: Could not start the connection with Google.
errors.googleNotConfigured: Google credentials are not configured on the server. Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in .env with the ones from Google Cloud Console and restart the server.
errors.disconnect: Could not disconnect. Please try again.

rules.title: Business hours
rules.intro: The assistant only offers times within these rules that are free on the calendar.
rules.maxDaysAhead: Book up to how many days ahead
rules.cancelNoticeHours: Cancel or reschedule up to (h before)

issue.no_open_day: Mark at least one day of business hours.
issue.end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
issue.day_shorter_than_appointment: The day is shorter than one appointment ({{minutes}} min).
issue.unrecognized_keys: Choose days from Monday to Sunday.
